svg.title: Tenohira Musei — The Voiceless Hand. Draft 4 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Waxing Crescent forks into Unspoken Blow then Deafening Silence, or Held Breath then Tipping the Balance. Waning Crescent forks into Hushed Inferno then Eclipse in Hand, or Bared to the Moon then Stillness Breaks. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu.

The Defensive and Control traits live in unsupported rows (seal on Silent Palm Strike, buffprevent/debuffprevent on Eternal Stillness, move on Silent Rift), so potency reaches control only through Moonlit Inferno's two 35% enemy debuffs (Decrease Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken, all four stat types, 40 AP) and Cascade's 35% exposure. Root Yang therefore carries the offense routes and root Yin the enemy-debuff routes. Root Yin (Waning Crescent, +2% exposure, +2% suppression) forks into a suppression route (Hushed Inferno \u2192 Eclipse in Hand) and an exposure route (Bared to the Moon \u2192 Stillness Breaks). 2/4/4 nodes; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP against the 4 BP cap.","Routes: Burst +5 Damage (Unspoken Blow +2, Deafening Silence +3); Amplifier +10% Increase Damage Given (Waxing Crescent +3%, Held Breath +2%, Tipping the Balance +5%); Suppression +10% Decrease Damage Given (Waning Crescent +2%, Hushed Inferno +3%, Eclipse in Hand +5%); Exposure +10% Increase Damage Taken (Waning Crescent +2%, Bared to the Moon +3%, Stillness Breaks +5%). Waxing Crescent stays a single-tag +3% Foundation (root Yang's only broad tag), so the Amplifier steps are 3/2/5. Capstone secondaries cross roots (+2% suppression, +2% self buff, +2 Damage); maxima over all legal allocations: Damage +5, every percentage tag +10%.","Filters (\u00a73): both self IDG rows are element-less or list None, so they match the kit's Yin-Yang hits, basic attacks and element-less normal jutsu; Moonlit Inferno's debuffs list all four stat types and no element, so they match every non-pierce source. Same-tag rows from different casts all apply (process.ts 1109\u20131117); the 25% + 0.15/level Increase Damage Given passive (fromType bloodline) is applied separately. IDG/IDT/DDG never touch pierce; no node touches seal, prevention or move.","Delivery and uptime: all casts cooldown 7; Rift, Cascade, Palm Strike 60 AP, Moonlit Inferno 40 AP. Each percentage row is live the two rounds after its cast round, never in it, so no cast's own buff or debuff touches its own hit (\u00a73b). Rift's IDG row is SELF: realized on the caster at cast time wherever they stand (actions.ts 980\u20131004, \u00a74b); Cascade's SELF IDG still lands if it is aimed at an ally (Damage/IDT withheld). Overlapping windows are ceilings, not rotations.","Fourth purchases: Burst Waning Crescent or Held Breath; Amplifier Waning Crescent or Unspoken Blow; Suppression Waxing Crescent or Bared to the Moon; Exposure Hushed Inferno or Waxing Crescent. 14 full builds, 12 non-dominated, every node in one. Hybrids 01+02+06+09 and 01+04+06+07 are dominated (by 01+06+09+10 and 01+06+07+08) because Stillness Breaks' +2 Damage and Eclipse in Hand's +2% self buff equal Unspoken Blow's and Held Breath's flats; accepted (+1 secondaries would clear both)."],"risks":["Self-buff reach: neither IDG row has a binding stat filter at the pin (Rift: Highest, no element; Cascade: Fire/Lightning/Yin-Yang/None), so the Amplifier route's 45% raises every matching normal jutsu, weapon and basic hit in its window, and the Rift and Cascade windows can both be live. Not simulated.","Exposure stacking: Moonlit Inferno's Increase Damage Taken (all four stat types, no element) and Cascade's (Highest, no element) are separate two-round debuffs that both apply to one target (process.ts 1109\u20131117); at the Exposure route maximum both are 45%, on player, ally and weapon hits. Pierce is unaffected.","Suppression concentration: Decrease Damage Given has one row (Moonlit Inferno, 40 AP, range 4, 2 rounds) and the route takes it to 45%; its whole value rides one single-target cast per seven rounds, and it does not reduce enemy pierce. Moonlit Inferno is the kit's only cast that this tree makes defensive.","Silent Rift delivery: its IDG row is target SELF on an EMPTY_GROUND AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN jutsu, so it is realized on the caster at cast time and live the two rounds after the cast round wherever the caster stands (actions.ts 980\u20131004; SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b, \u00a74b), never boosting Rift's own hit. The Damage row is friendly-fire ENEMIES; the only hazard-flagged row (move) is unsupported and untouched.","Classification: Yin-Yang is shared with other bloodlines (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 4 of 8 supported kit rows carry Yin-Yang; the rest need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Moonlit Inferno and Eternal Stillness (no Yin-Yang row) qualify in-kit only through an authored Yin-Yang jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Yin-Yang coverage is unverified.","Unsupported control: seal (Silent Palm Strike), buffprevent/debuffprevent (Eternal Stillness) and move (Silent Rift) receive nothing, so the bloodline's Defensive and Control traits are not strengthened by any route; the tree makes an A-rank control kit hit harder and debuff harder, which may read as off-trait to the user. Eternal Stillness is untouched by every build.","Dominance: 12 of 14 full builds are numerically non-dominated; the two dominated no-capstone hybrids are named in design_notes and accepted. The dominance count treats every tag as a gain and ignores delivery, so it is structural evidence only.","Context: skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and ranked sparring; normal-tree potency policy is not approved, so a combined stacking audit is required before implementation; Yin-Yang Cascade (3 supported rows) is touched by every route, making it the kit's load-bearing cast. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Tipping the Balance path + Waning Crescent
Eclipse in Hand path + Waxing Crescent
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE TENOHIRA MUSEI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 4 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
